LanguageData.FleshVeins.label: flesh veins
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonFlesh.label: lunar flesh
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonFlesh.description: A living flesh moon surface, grown as the ground itself rather than a layer over soil.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonFleshVeins.label: veined lunar flesh
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonFleshVeins.description: Veined living tissue grown through the flesh moon's ground, pulsing below the surface.
LanguageData.RootFlesh.label: rotten flesh
LanguageData.RootFlesh.description: A thick mat of flesh that has died where it grew into the floor. It does not spread, does not heal over, and simply stays where it settled.
LanguageData.RootFleshVeins.label: rotten flesh veins
LanguageData.RootFleshVeins.description: Vessels set in dead flesh. Nothing moves through them any more.
